summary: Xponential Fitness filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 12, 2026 the board adopted a Stockholder Rights Agreement with Computershare as rights agent, declaring a dividend of one right per Class A share of record October 22, 2026. Each right initially entitles holders to buy one one-thousandth of Series B Preferred at $15.00 per unit, adjusting to a 1/1000 preferred ratio; rights trade with common until separation. This is a poison-pill defense, not a takeover bid, suggesting an activist or accumulation threat; no stake, price or premium disclosed. Watch for 13D filings, pill trigger terms and any board or strategic response.
